name: ACE Web — CRISPR-Connect Lifecycle
narrative: Follow a CRISPR-Connect opportunity from IDD through the 19-skill pipeline, inspect results in the workbench, and discuss findings in chat.

jj.name: Jonathan Jackson
jj.intro: Jonathan leads the ACE initiative. He uses ace-web to monitor CRISPR-Connect opportunities, review pipeline progress, and discuss findings with the team.

slides.title: Opportunity dashboard
slides.narration: One-glance view of every opportunity's pipeline status. CRISPR-Test-001 is running.

ai_evaluation.commentary: Overall: 3/5. A: Content 3/5 — one opp visible, real data, but sparse (only 1 card on a full screen). B: App Page 3/5 — dark mode + Geist looks clean but massive whitespace. C: Screenshot 4/5. D: Slide 3/5 — tells the story. E: Demo Ready 3/5 — would benefit from more opps.

slides.title: Workbench — 19-skill pipeline
slides.narration: The full CRISPR-Connect pipeline: 19 skills grouped by phase, with status badges showing which steps completed, which are pending.

ai_evaluation.commentary: Overall: 3/5. A: Content 4/5 — real pipeline with real status data, 3 completed steps visible. B: App Page 3/5 — information-dense but hard to read at this zoom level, the right pane says "Select a step". C: Screenshot 3/5 — full page capture makes text small. D: Slide 3/5 — narration explains the pipeline concept. E: Demo Ready 3/5 — impressive data but needs zoomed crop for readability.

slides.title: IDD review — intervention design
slides.narration: The IDD for Community Health Worker Training Pilot rendered inline. The foundation document the entire pipeline builds from.

ai_evaluation.commentary: Overall: 3/5. A: Content 4/5 — real IDD content visible in the detail pane with Discuss in chat button. B: App Page 3/5 — three-pane layout works but text in the right pane is small. C: Screenshot 3/5 — thumbnail resolution makes the IDD body unreadable. D: Slide 3/5. E: Demo Ready 3/5 — would benefit from a zoomed crop of just the detail pane.

slides.title: Step detail — training materials
slides.narration: Drill into a completed step: 4 artifacts produced, judge score visible, and a Discuss in chat button to seed a conversation from this step.

ai_evaluation.commentary: Overall: 3/5. A: Content 4/5 — training-materials step selected with artifact count and judge data. B: App Page 3/5 — same three-pane layout, good selection highlight. C: Screenshot 3/5 — small at full-page zoom. D: Slide 3/5 — narration covers the key features. E: Demo Ready 3/5.

slides.title: Session library
slides.narration: Every conversation is persistent and searchable. Filter by status, search by title, archive old sessions.

ai_evaluation.commentary: Overall: 3/5. A: Content 3/5 — 7 curated sessions, no duplicates, but all same date. B: App Page 4/5 — dark mode library looks polished with Geist font, orange primary button. C: Screenshot 4/5 — clean. D: Slide 3/5. E: Demo Ready 3/5 — presentable with caveats about batch dates.

slides.title: Chat — discuss findings
slides.narration: Multi-player chat with real-time streaming, draft collaboration, and share links. The sidebar gives instant context across all conversations.

ai_evaluation.commentary: Overall: 2/5 (BLOCKED). A: Content 2/5 — CLI not connected banner, no assistant response. B: App Page 3/5 — dark mode chat looks clean. C: Screenshot 4/5. D: Slide 2/5 — narration promises streaming but the screen shows none. E: Demo Ready 2/5 — projector test: NO.

issues.description: Claude CLI not connected — chat streaming non-functional. Connect via /auth/cli.
Only 1 opportunity visible — dashboard looks sparse.
Workbench text is small at full-page zoom — consider cropped captures for workbench scenes.
